title: Conversation framing sanitizer and token-stream alignment for pinned model rollouts
creator: Asha Patel
description: Summary: New model bundles arriving from third-party contributors include inconsistent conversation framing (role delimiters, invisible separators, and control tokens) that leads to subtle tokenization mismatches when we pin model versions and publish performance profiles. This ticket implements a conservative 'conversation framing sanitizer' in the onboarding pipeline that normalizes role markers, strips invisible separators, and produces a canonical token-stream preview used to validate performance profile publishing and runtime pinning. Motivation: Without normalization, customers see token-level regressions after pinning (token counts differ from onboarding benchmark), and the profile publish job can publish misleading per-token latency/cost metrics. Goal: ensure the onboarding preview and published profile match the runtime tokenization the serving stack will produce for pinned models, and add safety checks to prevent profile publish if divergence > 3% or if unknown control tokens are present.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding pipeline emits a canonical token-stream sample for each model bundle and stores it as part of the model-profile artifact
Published performance profiles include canonical token counts and a hash fingerprint of the normalized conversation framing
Profile publish job aborts if canonical token count differs from runtime token count by >3% for representative prompts
Automated gating tests included: unit tests for delimiter normalization, integration test against runtime tokenizer shim, and e2e publish-to-console smoke test
No customer-facing regressions observed in canary rollout (latency and token-cost within 1% of pre-change baselines)
work_items: Add ConversationFramingSanitizer step to onboarding pipeline (pre-tokenize stage)
Implement a lightweight token-stream preview generator that runs the runtime tokenizer in CI container and records counts/hash
Update profile publish workflow to include token-stream fingerprint and canonical counts in the artifact manifest
Create gating checks that compare onboarding preview vs runtime against representative prompt set (store diffs)
Add telemetry: per-model onboarding token divergence metric and alert for >1% drift across recent bundles
Add documentation: PRD section and onboarding runbook with rollback steps
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Sanitizer could strip tokens that are meaningful to some model variants. Mitigation: default sanitizer is conservative (only normalize known delimiter variations and invisible separators), and we include a whitelist toggle per-model for opt-out

Risk: Increased onboarding time due to runtime tokenizer runs. Mitigation: run preview on a sampled prompt set and use a short-circuit fast-mode for initial publish, with full verification during nightly profile reconciler

Risk: False positives on publish gating causing blocked releases. Mitigation: gating threshold conservative (3%) and provide an escape hatch in console for manual review and force-publish with audit log
comments: 2026-02-25 - Asha Patel: Created ticket after two customer reports where token counts post-pinning were 4-7% higher than onboarding benchmarks. Initial notes link attached.

2026-03-01 - Ben Carter: Implemented initial sanitizer prototype that normalizes '\u200b' zero-width spaces and common role delimiter aliases (User:, user:, U:). Running unit tests locally—all passing. Open PR: onboarding#214
2026-03-03 - Design (Maya Lin): Reviewed examples; requested we preserve original raw text in artifact for debugging and include a human-readable diff in the console UI. Added to acceptance criteria.

2026-03-05 - QA (Diego Alvarez): Built integration job that runs runtime tokenizer inside a container to validate preview counts. Found one model where control token '<|control|>' was introduced by conversion script — flagged to model-onboarding team.

2026-03-07 - Ben Carter: Updated PR to add per-model opt-out flag 'preserve_raw_framing' and added telemetry event 'onboarding.token_divergence'. Benchmarked onboarding runtime: preview step adds ~150ms per model bundle on average in fast-mode.
2026-03-09 - PM (Eleanor Shaw): Approved gating thresholds and canary plan. Canary will run against 10% of new model publishes for two weeks; manual review flow documented in onboarding runbook.
2026-03-10 - Ben Carter: Merged runtime shim PR that exposes tokenizer fingerprint endpoint. Next: wire publish workflow to read fingerprint and abort when divergence>3%.
notes: Plan: implement sanitizer and preview in two-week sprint; run canary and iterate on thresholds. If we see >5% divergence in canary, initiate rollback path and open incident postmortem. Coordinate with model-onboarding and runtime teams for kernel-level tokenizer changes.
